items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: He played piano with John Robichaud.

ctx.x: He was from, he was from Miss Lula's home, I think, of White Castle, too. He played piano with John Robichaud.
Did you hear the John Robichaud band yourself? Huh? Did you hear that band, the John Robichaud band?
